statement: Wiiuse's pinned MP probe accepts a separate inactive builtin MotionPlus identifier code and uses the same MP activation mode 04 or 05 for compatible input; Dolphin emulated MP encodes a presumed integrated ID first-byte distinction but deliberately selects detachable/nonintegrated because users can disconnect emulated attachment. Linux Gen 2's builtin policy disables hotplug polling. These support physically permanently present but logically switchable MP, not exact early/TR inactive A600FA/6 bytes or an observed revision-specific mapped identity.

applicability.revision: Original RVL-003, early integrated RVL-036 non-TR, later RVL-036 TR; no physical revision measured
applicability.scope: evidence_role: device. wiiuse motion_plus.c 42-80,175-205, internal.h 227-242; Dolphin MotionPlus.cpp 95-108; Linux v6.12 modules.c 2630-2667; WiiBrew oldid120079 has external MP mapping and is not integrated physical readback. All proposed physical or host tests are not run.
